title: Versailles, inhabited by chickens
content: What if Versailles in 1700 were inhabited by chickens? The galline courtesans are elegant but dimwitted, so inevitably decorum dissolves and chaos ensues. In this seven-minute CGI animated film, created as a graduation project, the character design and comic timing are fresh and memorable.
